title: File Relationship Configuration
description: Configuration for recognizing file hyperlinks as custom work item relationships

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g., '1.0'). Used for migration between schema versions.

patterns.description: Array of file relationship pattern definitions

FileRelationshipPattern.description: A single URL pattern configuration for recognizing file artifacts

urlPattern.description: Regex pattern with named capture groups to match hyperlink URLs

relationshipName.description: The relationship type name displayed (e.g., 'Architecture Decision')

workItemType.description: The work item type for generated fake work items

startWorkItemId.description: Base ID for fake work items (actual ID = startWorkItemId + computed offset)

fieldMappings.description: Maps work item fields to values. Use ${CaptureGroupName} syntax for dynamic substitution from regex captures; values without ${...} are used as static literals.

contentExtractionPatterns.description: Optional regex patterns for extracting field values from file content. Patterns are applied in order; last match wins for each field (top-to-bottom). File content is only fetched when --resolve-file-content (-rfc) is specified AND at least one pattern is configured.

ContentExtractionPattern.description: A regex pattern for extracting fields from file content

pattern.description: Regex pattern with named capture groups. Each named group maps to a field. Use flags like (?s) for DOTALL, (?m) for MULTILINE. Example: '(?m)^## Status:\s*(?<State>\w+)' to extract State from Markdown.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this pattern extracts
